directions: Directions; For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write on the topic Changes in the Way of Transportation. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
The way of transportation has witnessed remarkable changes over the years. To begin with, the means of transportation have become more diverse. In the past, people mainly relied on bicycles and buses. However, nowadays, we have a wide range of choices, such as subways, high-speed trains, and even shared bikes. For example, the subway provides a fast and convenient way to travel in big cities, saving people a lot of time.

In addition, the speed of transportation has significantly increased. High-speed trains can reach speeds of over 300 kilometers per hour, making long-distance travel much quicker. This has not only facilitated business trips but also promoted tourism. Moreover, the comfort level has been greatly improved. Modern vehicles are equipped with better seats, air-conditioning, and entertainment systems, offering passengers a more pleasant journey.

In conclusion, these changes in the way of transportation have brought great convenience to our lives. They have made our travel faster, more comfortable, and more efficient, and will continue to evolve in the future.
